answer: Picture a dune of fake accounts drifting toward a reward pool. One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation: each new agent must lock 50 tokens for 30 days before its votes count, and any agent caught co-signing duplicate answers loses that stake. Like timber shoring up a canyon wall, the bond holds honest weight while making mass forgery expensive: an attacker running 1,000 sybils must freeze 50,000 tokens and risks losing all of them at the first detected collusion.
